title: 架空電車線懸掛系統~Overhead contact-line suspension systems
focus: 接觸線懸掛張力垂度與溫度補償~Contact-wire suspension tension sag and thermal compensation
summary: 架空電車線懸掛系統以「接觸線懸掛張力垂度與溫度補償」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。架空電車線同時是導電路徑與受拉結構，跨距、張力和支承彈性共同決定受流幾何，靜態高度並不能代表列車通過的動態接觸。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops contact-wire suspension tension sag and thermal compensation through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. An overhead contact line is both a conductor and a tension structure; span, tension and support flexibility determine current-collection geometry, while static height does not establish dynamic contact. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把架空電車線懸掛系統放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。架空電車線同時是導電路徑與受拉結構，跨距、張力和支承彈性共同決定受流幾何，靜態高度並不能代表列車通過的動態接觸。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places Overhead contact-line suspension systems in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. An overhead contact line is both a conductor and a tension structure; span, tension and support flexibility determine current-collection geometry, while static height does not establish dynamic contact. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：w=10 N/m, L=50 m, T=15000 N；y=w*L**2/(8*T)=0.208333 m。只把 w 增加百分之十，y=0.229167 m。模型邊界：均勻載重小垂度弦；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：T=15000 N, mu=1.35 kg/m；y=sqrt(T/mu)=105.409 m/s。只把 T 增加百分之十，y=110.554 m/s。模型邊界：均勻柔弦無彎曲剛度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: w=10 N/m, L=50 m, T=15000 N; y=w*L**2/(8*T)=0.208333 m. Increasing only w with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.229167 m. Boundary: Uniformly loaded small-sag string; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: T=15000 N, mu=1.35 kg/m; y=sqrt(T/mu)=105.409 m/s. Increasing only T with a ten-percent increase gives y=110.554 m/s. Boundary: Uniform flexible string without bending rigidity; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.anchor: 跨中垂度近似~Midspan sag approximation
units.title: 跨中垂度近似~Midspan sag approximation
units.mechanism: 小垂度近似中跨距平方放大垂度。本模型把 w 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.229167 m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均勻載重小垂度弦。使用張力與跨中高度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；張力下降會改變靜態接觸高度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Span squared amplifies sag in the small-sag approximation. In this model, w is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.229167 m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniformly loaded small-sag string. Use tension and midspan level as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Loss of tension changes static contact height; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：w=10 N/m, L=50 m, T=15000 N；y=w*L**2/(8*T)=0.208333 m。只把 w 增加百分之十，y=0.229167 m。模型邊界：均勻載重小垂度弦；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: w=10 N/m, L=50 m, T=15000 N; y=w*L**2/(8*T)=0.208333 m. Increasing only w with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.229167 m. Boundary: Uniformly loaded small-sag string; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以張力與跨中高度區分模型與觀察，先用模型張力計與高度尺建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「跨中垂度近似」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use tension and midspan level to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model tensiometer and height gauge, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Midspan sag approximation. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 張力下降會改變靜態接觸高度。這個失效與「跨中垂度近似」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查張力與跨中高度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Loss of tension changes static contact height. This failure and a measurement bias in Midspan sag approximation can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check tension and midspan level rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：張力下降會改變靜態接觸高度~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Loss of tension changes static contact height.
units.practice: 重算「跨中垂度近似」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出均勻載重小垂度弦如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由張力下降會改變靜態接觸高度造成偏離的合成觀察，以張力與跨中高度說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Midspan sag approximation, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Uniformly loaded small-sag string. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Loss of tension changes static contact height. Explain which evidence in tension and midspan level distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 弦波傳播速度~String wave speed
units.title: 弦波傳播速度~String wave speed
units.mechanism: 橫波速度由張力與線密度比決定。本模型把 T 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 110.554 m/s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均勻柔弦無彎曲剛度。使用脈衝傳播時間作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；局部附加質量會改變波傳，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Transverse wave speed depends on tension-to-line-density ratio. In this model, T is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 110.554 m/s. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform flexible string without bending rigidity. Use pulse propagation time as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Local added mass changes wave propagation; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

units.anchor: 接觸線熱伸長~Contact-wire thermal expansion
units.title: 接觸線熱伸長~Contact-wire thermal expansion
units.mechanism: 長導線的熱伸長需要張力補償行程。本模型把 alpha 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.561 m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均溫自由熱伸長。使用線溫與補償位置作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；補償卡阻會讓熱伸長轉為張力變化，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Thermal growth of a long conductor consumes compensation travel. In this model, alpha is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.561 m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform-temperature free expansion. Use wire temperature and compensator position as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A stuck compensator converts expansion into tension change; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.000017 1/K, L=1000 m, dT=30 K；y=alpha*L*dT=0.51 m。只把 alpha 增加百分之十，y=0.561 m。模型邊界：均溫自由熱伸長；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.000017 1/K, L=1000 m, dT=30 K; y=alpha*L*dT=0.51 m. Increasing only alpha with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.561 m. Boundary: Uniform-temperature free expansion; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

Establish a baseline using wire thermometer and compensator travel gauge, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Contact-wire thermal expansion. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 補償卡阻會讓熱伸長轉為張力變化。這個失效與「接觸線熱伸長」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查線溫與補償位置，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~A stuck compensator converts expansion into tension change. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

units.anchor: 張力補償機械比~Compensator force ratio
units.title: 張力補償機械比~Compensator force ratio
units.mechanism: 理想滑輪比改變力與行程的交換。本模型把 weight 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 16500 N。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。無摩擦準靜態滑輪。使用重錘位移與線端位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；摩擦使實際張力不同於理想值，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Ideal pulley ratio trades force against travel. In this model, weight is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 16500 N. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Frictionless quasistatic pulley. Use counterweight and wire-end movements as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Friction separates actual tension from ideal tension; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：weight=5000 N, ratio=3 1；y=weight*ratio=15000 N。只把 weight 增加百分之十，y=16500 N。模型邊界：無摩擦準靜態滑輪；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: weight=5000 N, ratio=3 1; y=weight*ratio=15000 N. Increasing only weight with a ten-percent increase gives y=16500 N. Boundary: Frictionless quasistatic pulley; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以重錘位移與線端位移區分模型與觀察，先用低載滑輪與力計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「張力補償機械比」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use counterweight and wire-end movements to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-load pulley and force gauge, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Compensator force ratio. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 摩擦使實際張力不同於理想值。這個失效與「張力補償機械比」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查重錘位移與線端位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Friction separates actual tension from ideal tension. This failure and a measurement bias in Compensator force ratio can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check counterweight and wire-end movements rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：摩擦使實際張力不同於理想值~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Friction separates actual tension from ideal tension.
units.practice: 重算「張力補償機械比」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出無摩擦準靜態滑輪如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由摩擦使實際張力不同於理想值造成偏離的合成觀察，以重錘位移與線端位移說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Compensator force ratio, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Frictionless quasistatic pulley. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Friction separates actual tension from ideal tension. Explain which evidence in counterweight and wire-end movements distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 導線直流電阻~Conductor DC resistance
units.title: 導線直流電阻~Conductor DC resistance
units.mechanism: 電阻由材料電阻率與長度面積比決定。本模型把 rho 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.157667 ohm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均溫直流均勻斷面。使用導線溫度與四線電阻作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；磨耗減面積會提高電阻，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Resistance depends on resistivity and length-to-area ratio. In this model, rho is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.157667 ohm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform-temperature DC conductor with constant area. Use wire temperature and four-terminal resistance as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Wear-reduced area raises resistance; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

units.title: 風載橫向位移~Wind-load lateral displacement

units.anchor: 懸掛點彈性位移~Suspension-point elastic movement
units.title: 懸掛點彈性位移~Suspension-point elastic movement
units.mechanism: 支承點彈性會參與接觸線高度變化。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 5.5 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。線性單點支承。使用支點力位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把支點視為完全固定會低估動態位移，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Support elasticity contributes to contact-wire height change. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 5.5 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Linear single-point support. Use support force-displacement as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Perfectly fixed supports can understate dynamic movement; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=100 N, k=20000 N/m；y=F/k*1000=5 mm。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=5.5 mm。模型邊界：線性單點支承；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=100 N, k=20000 N/m; y=F/k*1000=5 mm. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=5.5 mm. Boundary: Linear single-point support; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以支點力位移區分模型與觀察，先用模型彈簧與位移計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「懸掛點彈性位移」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use support force-displacement to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model spring and displacement gauge, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Suspension-point elastic movement. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 把支點視為完全固定會低估動態位移。這個失效與「懸掛點彈性位移」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查支點力位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Perfectly fixed supports can understate dynamic movement. This failure and a measurement bias in Suspension-point elastic movement can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check support force-displacement rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把支點視為完全固定會低估動態位移~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Perfectly fixed supports can understate dynamic movement.
units.practice: 重算「懸掛點彈性位移」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出線性單點支承如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把支點視為完全固定會低估動態位移造成偏離的合成觀察，以支點力位移說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Suspension-point elastic movement, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Linear single-point support. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Perfectly fixed supports can understate dynamic movement. Explain which evidence in support force-displacement distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
